name: market-data-mcp-server
description: MCP server for real-time stock quotes, price history, analyst consensus, and options data via Alpha Vantage API.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fetch the current stock quote for a ticker — price, change, volume, day range.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Fetch historical daily prices for a ticker over a specified period.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

period.description: Number of days of history to return (default: 30)

tools.name: get_analyst_consensus
tools.description: Fetch analyst consensus estimates — target price, P/E, EPS, profit margin, beta, 52-week range.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description: Fetch options-related data summary — beta, moving averages, short interest, 52-week range.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)
